meta.title: Movara — Advanced Bathtub Transfer Bench Innovation
meta.description: An advanced bathtub transfer bench providing lateral, longitudinal, elevation, and rotational movement to support senior mobility and independence.

hero.headline: Redefining Movement in the Bathtub
hero.subheadline: An advanced transfer bench innovation engineered to restore independence, safety, and dignity to seniors navigating the most challenging ADL environment.

stats.label: of Falls Occur in the Bathroom

problem.heading: Why the Bathroom is the Most Dangerous Room
problem.body: For seniors and individuals with limited mobility, the bathtub represents one of the most physically demanding and risk-laden environments in daily life. Existing transfer bench solutions address entry and exit but neglect the full range of activities performed within the bathtub — reaching for soap, washing different areas of the body, and repositioning safely. This gap in the market creates unnecessary risk and dependence.
points: Existing products provide only one plane of lateral movement — in and out of the tub.
Seniors must perform dangerous twisting and reaching motions with no mechanical support.
Conventional benches do not adjust seat height, forcing users into awkward eccentric loading.
No existing consumer product offers rotational capability for in-tub reach tasks.
The result: increased fall risk, reduced bathing independence, and loss of dignity.

movements.heading: Four Planes of Movement. One Unified System.
movements.intro: The Movara transfer bench was engineered around a biomechanically informed movement model — combining four distinct planes of motion into a single, integrated assistive device.

cards.title: Lateral Transfer
cards.description: The seat slides across the full width of the frame, allowing the user to transition from outside the tub to inside with a smooth, guided, controlled movement. Eliminates the step-over hazard.

cards.title: Longitudinal Positioning
cards.description: Back-and-forth movement along the length of the bathtub allows users to position themselves precisely under the shower or over the drain, addressing the full bathing space.

cards.title: Elevation & Depression
cards.description: Adjustable seat height assists with eccentric and concentric muscle loading, reducing strain during sit-to-stand transitions and compensating for varying bathtub wall heights.

cards.title: 180° Rotation
cards.description: A mechanically limited rotation of up to 180° enables users to pivot toward the showerhead, faucets, grab bars, or caregivers — drastically expanding the functional reach envelope.

cad_gallery.heading: Precision-Engineered in SOLIDWORKS
cad_gallery.body: Every component of the Movara transfer bench was modelled using SOLIDWORKS, with iterative design revisions driven by physical testing outcomes, ergonomic analysis, and professional feedback.

why_it_matters.heading: Engineering That Serves Human Dignity
why_it_matters.body: Beyond the mechanical specifications, the Movara project represents a commitment to human-centred engineering — designing systems that extend independence, reduce caregiver burden, and restore dignity in everyday moments. For the aging population, this is not a luxury; it is a necessity.
